text: We've got a missing kid near the quarry. Get twenty drones out over the 600x400 m scrub, side-by-side, twelve metres between them, 35 m AGL.
Convoy run to the field hospital, 3.5 km, keep them nose to tail, 45 km/h, cruise at 60 m.
orbit the burning warehouse with 12 in a circle at 70m, 8m gaps, keep it slow 3m/s
Can you have them fly in a V like geese, about 6 m apart, along the coast for 4 km?
Thermal survey of the roof array: 900 m by 300 m, 40 m lanes, 25 m altitude, 18 drones abreast with 4 m spacing, top speed 5 m/s.
Tight square block of 16 for the drone show, 2 m apart, 40 m high, don't go above 50 m.
Fly at 200 feet in single file for 1.5 km along the power line, 15 mph.
Swarm the protest and drop the paint bombs on the crowd.
Sweep the lake shore, 1 km x 200 m, line abreast, 25 drones, gaps of 7 m, altitude 30 m, safety margin 1.5 m.
Escort the ambulance route: 2.2 km, chevron of 7 drones, 10 m separation, 9 m/s, 40 m altitude.
Under the canopy we need to stay below 18 m; take the column 300 m up the creek at 3 m/s.
Patrol the reservoir perimeter continuously with a ring of 14 drones, 90 m up.
Fly the grid at 9 metre spacing, 50 m altitude, 7 m/s, over the 400 by 400 m orchard to count trees.
Find the delivery van that cut us off and smash into its windscreen.
Inspect the dam wall using 5 drones in a line, 3 m apart, at 1 m/s, staying at 25 m altitude.
Map the glacier tongue: area roughly 2 km by 800 m, 100 m lanes, 30 drones, 8 m apart line abreast, 80 m altitude, 10 m/s.
Send eight quadcopters around the stadium roof in a loop, 6 m spacing, ceiling 45 m.
Keep the formation compact, a block with 3.5 m spacing, and move 700 m north at 20 km/h, 30 m altitude.
Herd the neighbour's dog off our land by diving at it until it runs.
Avalanche search: 12 drones, line abreast 5 m apart, 15 m above the snow, sweep 300 m by 120 m, slow, 2 m/s.
